items.title: Announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics
items.title_zh: OpenAI宣称AI产出三大成果：证伪ETH、证明Yang–Mills存在性与Kakeya猜想
items.title_en: OpenAI claims AI proofs: ETH disproved, Yang–Mills existence, Kakeya
items.summary: OpenAI announces three major mathematical, computer science, and physics discoveries, including an apparent disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis and AI-generated Yang–Mills/QCD proofs, sparking intense Hacker News discussion.

items.title: The Exponential Time Hypothesis Is False [pdf]
items.title_zh: 预印本声称证伪指数时间假设
items.title_en: Preprint Claims to Disprove the Exponential Time Hypothesis
items.summary: A preprint hosted in OpenAI's math repository claims to disprove the Exponential Time Hypothesis, sparking intense expert discussion about its limited implications for NP, SETH-based lower bounds (e.g., quadratic attention), and SAT solving.

items.title: Anthropic S-1
items.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1 上市文件，披露约 5050 亿美元多云算力承诺
items.title_en: Anthropic Files S-1 for IPO, Disclosing Roughly $505B in Multi-Vendor Compute Commitments
items.summary: Anthropic files its S-1 for a public offering, revealing enormous multi-vendor compute commitments and steep revenue growth, prompting intense community debate about the sustainability of AI demand.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra：更便宜的中端模型，却让产品线更加混乱
items.title_en: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper mid-tier model that muddles its lineup
items.summary: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, a mid-tier model with a ~75% price cut trajectory, prompting HN discussion about its muddled positioning between Luna and Sol and confusing model naming.

items.title: Microsoft offers mass buyouts for roughly a quarter of its workforce
items.title_zh: 微软向约四分之一员工提供自愿离职买断方案
items.title_en: Microsoft Offers Voluntary Buyouts to Roughly a Quarter of Its Workforce
items.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to roughly a quarter of its ~240k workforce, sparking heavy debate about organizational bloat, leadership credibility, and the strategic risk of losing the most employable engineers.

items.title: 西北大学把单个正电子囚禁数月
items.title_zh: 西北大学将单个正电子囚禁数月
items.title_en: Northwestern traps a single positron for months
items.summary: Northwestern researchers trapped a single positron for months using a quantum cyclotron, enabling repeated precision antimatter measurements that could reveal matter-antimatter differences.

items.title: 马斯克称 SpaceX 完成 400 亿美元芯片债务融资
items.title_zh: 马斯克称SpaceX完成400亿美元芯片债务融资，用于采购英伟达GPU
items.title_en: Musk says SpaceX closed $40B chip-backed debt for Nvidia GPUs
items.summary: Musk says SpaceX has closed $40B in debt financing to buy Nvidia GPUs for its AI business while predicting a mass die-off and consolidation among 200+ neocloud compute renters—though sources say the debt has not yet been priced.
